conclusions.wave_1: Seven exact host/configuration findings are fully verified. The other 69 locally required Wave 1 runtime contracts remain pending.
conclusions.wave_2: All 48 runtime rows have exact final-source hosted CPU regression evidence, but none has the required target-hardware acceptance cell; all remain awaiting_runtime.
conclusions.adjacent: LOCAL-006, LOCAL-024, and LOCAL-027 advance only the bounded subgates named in the receipt; no adjacent awaiting_runtime row fully closes.

precision_limits: A passing hosted CPU/source regression does not qualify CUDA, NCCL, sanitizer, profiler, device, numerical, or performance behavior.
The 461 JUnit skips are heterogeneous and are not uniformly capability skips or passing protection coverage.
W1-067 closes the exact dead Make ARCH-knob mechanism; it does not qualify the lab binary on a device.
W1-055 and W1-057 close static identity and build-routing defects; live device discovery and kernel qualification are separate contracts.
No retained pre-final-source receipt is used to close a final-source hardware gate.
